title: Households through adversity
disclaimer: An authored eight-season exercise, not evidence for an attack or siege at Yenikapı around 6000 BCE. No army, enemy identity or historical cultural revolution is reconstructed. The danger is a fictional warning that restricts travel; the later learning circle models uneven household adoption of a shared craft practice.
intro: Follow daily life inside a home, shared store and work room. Prepare finite supplies, support care and keep routes usable. Households remember stress and take up new practices at different rates.
complete: The authored danger has passed. Household memories and chosen care or learning routines continue; no city stage is automatically unlocked.

stages.label: Warning arrives
stages.description: A fictional warning of hostile movement makes households bring useful goods indoors. The community still gathers outside, but uncertainty costs time.
stages.hint: The steward can secure stores and prepare shared care. The watch leader can support safe routes. Keep people assigned to food.

stages.label: Movement restricted
stages.description: The authored danger peaks. Some gathering is forgone and frightened households seek company indoors. Safe routes need watch labor; refuge care needs care labor every season.
stages.hint: Check the food forecast before resolving. Paid preparations cannot replace workers. Care lowers the stress that will persist after danger.

stages.label: Repair and return
stages.description: No attacker is simulated. In this chapter the warning passes, and households begin to resume work. Stress recedes gradually; familiar possessions remain.
stages.hint: Keep care staffed while households recover. A learning circle can begin now, at an explicit seasonal food opportunity cost.

stages.label: Share a new practice
stages.description: Households can visit a small learning circle. Uptake is deliberately uneven: a teaching model of cultural change, not a recovered historical revolution.
stages.hint: Learning needs care labor and costs food each season. Compare household practice and stress rather than expecting a uniform upgrade.

stages.label: Memories remain
stages.description: Ordinary movement resumes. Household stress continues to ease and learned practice remains. Standing care and learning orders can be changed or stopped.
stages.hint: Continue the town tutorial or explore interiors. Paid preparations remain available, but inactive orders consume no seasonal learning food.

orders.label: Secure shared stores
orders.description: Fit reusable covers and lift provisions onto racks. One care worker maintains them; gathering disruption eases during warning and danger.

orders.label: Prepare shared care
orders.description: Lay extra mats and ready water and bowls in the home. Two care workers support frightened households and reduce accumulating stress.

orders.label: Maintain safe routes
orders.description: Set a watch rota for existing paths. Two watch workers mitigate gathering disruption and protect access; no wall or standing army appears.

orders.label: Hold a learning circle
orders.description: Prepare a small working surface for a shared craft practice. From recovery onward, two care workers support uneven household uptake. Gathering must cover the seasonal food opportunity cost as well as any remaining disruption.

ui.inactive: Optional chapter: explore a village under pressure, then recovery and uneven cultural renewal. This does not begin a documented siege.
ui.labor: Existing care and watch assignments provide the labor. The care crew supports shared care, store upkeep and learning in aggregate; these are not extra workers or separate full-time posts. Minimum staffing continues each season. Learning also forgoes food output. Learning waits if gathering cannot cover that cost.
ui.paid: Preparation retained; switching it on again costs no wood.
ui.understaffed: Waiting for required care/watch labor or gathering capacity
ui.learning_wait: Learning becomes effective from recovery onward.
ui.effects: Next season: {food} food forgone · wellbeing {wellbeing} · cooperation {cooperation} · protection {security}
ui.interpretation: Click a nearby visible resident to inspect their activity, or choose a name above. All furnishings, individual routines, care arrangements and practice scores are interpretive. Animation does not advance time.
